Like most trolls, Dad was named after his first attempt to eat his own father. Like a giant rock, there's not a great deal of intellect there, but some impressive might. You've been warned.

Quest: Troll Stronghold

Combat: As well as bashing your brains in with melee combat, Dad has an attack that will hit through pretty much any defence, knocking you back a few paces.
